Name: CrabPotAnyFish
Author: 964201902mod
Description:
让蟹笼可以捕到**所有鱼类（包括模组新增的鱼）**，不受地区、水域、季节和时间的限制；捕到的鱼的**星级可以在 Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）里设置**。

作者：**cherrystudio & deepseekV4.1**

Makes crab pots catch **every fish — including fish added by other mods** — with no location, water type, season or time restrictions. Fish quality is selectable in Generic Mod Config Menu.

Created by **cherrystudio & deepseekV4.1**.
